name: CryptoPanic bullish-vote surge + momentum confirmation (spot long)
rationale: MECHANISM (why the vote surge leads price): CryptoPanic bullish votes are a real-time crowd-attention/optimism tally on news posts mentioning the coin. A surge marks a fresh burst of retail attention forming around a catalyst BEFORE that attention fully translates into buying pressure — an attention-momentum lead. Paired with positive ret_Nd (price already confirming, so we are not chasing a headline with no follow-through) it isolates attention that is actually driving flow. Exit when the vote surge fades (attention rolling over) or stop/TP/time. DISCONFIRMER 1: if plain momentum without the vote arm matches the deflated Sharpe, the votes add nothing. DISCONFIRMER 2: CryptoPanic votes are noisy and their base rate drifts with total platform traffic — if the fitted floor lands where it is nearly always-true, the signal is a level artifact, not attention; the Gate's deflated Sharpe must kill that. Requires CRYPTOPANIC_API_KEY; low-confidence until validated OOS.
catalyst: cryptopanic_bullish_votes spike on coin news while price momentum (ret_Nd) is positive.
